subject: Re: Kickoff: romanized Hindi/Urdu routing
body:
Priya,

Resourcing for the short window.

Staffing Feb-April: Nikhil 50% on training and the source-comparison experiments, Rafael 40% on the seed-word pipeline and data QA, Katya 30% on integration with the language-ID service.

Compute: trivial -- these are small classifiers, a couple of Titan A100s.

Data logistics: the released tarball reassembles from its 65 chunks cleanly and is staged. The forward-looking item is the refresh cadence, since mc4-derived training data goes stale. The Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-06-26, so the mc4 hi-Latn refresh needs to be ingested well before that date. Rafael will file the ingestion request in March so we are not scrambling; after the freeze we would be stuck on the old snapshot for a quarter.

Feb 20 data-staging milestone is effectively done already.

Alina
